requirements.title: OPEN character specifier values ignore trailing blanks and case
requirements.definition: Some OPEN specifiers have limited character values; trailing blanks are ignored, values are interpreted without regard to case, and some specifiers have defaults when omitted.

pending.limited-character-values: For each specifier-specific catalogue, use only values listed by that specifier and assert the portable mode/effect registered there.
pending.trailing-blanks-ignored: Use a listed value padded with trailing blanks and compare to an unpadded control by observing the same portable mode effect.
pending.case-insensitive-values: Use lower/mixed case for a value whose later behavior is portable, and compare to uppercase control without asserting IOMSG text.
pending.omitted-specifier-defaults-exist: For fixed OPEN defaults, use the concrete specifier-specific plans registered in the owning specifier catalogues. Where INQUIRE reports the mode/state that the default establishes (for example ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and bounded ROUND), initialize the inquiry result variable to a nonmatching sentinel and assert only the token or token set fixed by that catalogue and the corresponding 12.10.2.x rule. Where INQUIRE reports connection state rather than the OPEN token, or no INQUIRE specifier exists, follow the owning catalogue's behavior/no-oracle plan instead (for example POSITION and STATUS); processor-dependent defaults must not assert a particular processor choice or any IOMSG text.

review_rationale: Source registration for the OPEN statement and its specifiers, 12.5.6.1-12.5.6.19 (batch151). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds. Round 1 found required OPEN defaults with only generic plans and required default tokens over-suppressed as unobservable; both are now concrete sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans (ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and ROUND as set membership). Rounds 2 and 3 found that INQUIRE(POSITION=) reports connection STATE, not the omitted OPEN token, and that a re-OPEN plan observes 12.5.6.1 p6 rather than the POSITION default; the omitted POSITION= token is now recorded as not portably observable, as are the STATUS and ENCODING default tokens. The eight numbered rules R1204-R1207 and C1203-C1206 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
